message.content: Handlers return a mode/data reply hash instead of a bare status string because this design supports multiple reply formats simultaneously — the 'mode' and 'data' fields can be used independently or together depending on the operation. A bare status string would either force all operations into one format or require conditional branching for each handler, complicating the calling logic. By always returning a hash, the caller can inspect which fields are present and handle each case accordingly, keeping handler implementations uniform and avoiding duplication.
